statements: Alkaloids are important in pharmacy and medicine because numerous alkaloids have therapeutic uses.
Morphine and codeine are strong narcotic painkillers.
Cocaine, caffeine, and cathinone act as central-nervous-system stimulants.
Psilocybin, dimethyltryptamine, and ibogaine are indole alkaloids with hallucinogenic effects.
Certain alkaloids are valuable precursors for semisynthetic medicines.
Thebaine is used to synthesize painkillers such as oxycodone.
Ephedrine and pseudoephedrine are used to produce other psychoactive drugs.
Atropine and tubocurarine are examples of potentially toxic alkaloids.
